text: publish_article must lock the PublishJob row with select_for_update() inside transaction.atomic(); without it two workers can publish the same article twice.
Run publishing tests: pytest cms/publishing --ds=config.settings.test -q. Needs Postgres from docker compose; SQLite is not supported.
Tests run Celery eager (CELERY_TASK_ALWAYS_EAGER in config/settings/test.py); to assert backoff, patch the task's retry() and check the countdown kwarg.
Publishing tasks retry via autoretry_for=(Exception,) with max_retries=10; don't add manual retry logic to publish_article.
publish_article no longer uses autoretry_for: it calls self.retry(countdown=30 * 2**attempts) and gives up after PUBLISH_MAX_ATTEMPTS=6.
Scheduled publishing runs on the default 'celery' queue; workers are started without a -Q flag.
Workers are split by queue: run publishing with `celery -A config worker -Q publish -c 2`; the default queue only handles email and thumbnails.
Lint with flake8 + isort: `make lint` before pushing.
Lint is ruff only (flake8 and isort were removed): `ruff check . && ruff format --check .`
Commit subjects: '<app>: <imperative summary>'; test-only commits use 'test(<app>): ...'.
Every migration needs a working reverse; CI runs `manage.py migrate <app> zero` on a fresh DB to check it.
Broker visibility_timeout is 3600s: any countdown or eta longer than an hour gets redelivered and executed twice.
CDN purge 4xx responses are permanent: mark the job failed at once. Only timeouts and 5xx are worth another attempt.
Article post_save (cms/articles/signals.py) enqueues a search reindex unless update_fields skips title/body; worker code should always pass update_fields.
Newsletter digest (cms/newsletter/tasks.py) sends 500 recipients per chunk to stay under the SES rate limit.
The Publish button in frontend/editor/PublishBar.tsx stays disabled until autosave resolves; don't wire it to the save request.
Image renditions: regenerate with `manage.py rebuild_renditions --since 7d` after changing crop presets.
Search is OpenSearch 2; rebuild the local index with `manage.py search_index --rebuild -f`.
Paywall meter rules live in cms/paywall/rules.yaml and hot-reload; meter changes don't need a deploy.
Local setup: `docker compose up -d db redis`, `uv sync`, `python manage.py migrate`; Python 3.12.
Release: tag vYYYY.MM.N on main; deploy runs migrations, then swaps web pods, and workers restart last.
PRs that change Celery routing or queues need a 'Rollout' section; ops scales the worker deployments from it.
Settings split: base.py shared, dev.py local, test.py for pytest; never import dev settings in tests.
mypy --strict is enforced only for cms/publishing and cms/paywall; run `mypy cms/publishing` before pushing changes there.
